title: Contraction with the Euler field preserves test forms
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let β : ℝ^P → Λ^{m+1}(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) be a test form (IsTestForm β: C^∞ with compact support). Then the contraction of β with the Euler field X(z) = z, ι_Xβ : z ↦ β(z).curryLeft z (so (ι_Xβ)(z)(v_1, …, v_m) = β(z)(z, v_1, …, v_m)), is a test m-form: IsTestForm (fun z => ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft (β z) z).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)), IsTestForm β → IsTestForm (fun z => ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft (β z) z)
